label: Nearby essentials estimate
status: editorial proximity heuristic, not an official or validated walkability rating
distanceType: great-circle straight-line distance between displayed points
categoryFormula: 100 at distance <=400m; otherwise max(0,100*(2000-distanceM)/1600), for an observed point within 2000m.
unknownHandling: If no mapped point is observed within 2000m for a category, its score is null, status is not-observed-within-range, and its weight is excluded. A failed/unloaded source or an origin outside the covered study geography likewise cannot produce zero.
overallFormula: Round(sum(weight*categoryScore)/sum(observedWeights)). Return null unless at least 4 of 6 categories and at least 70 of 100 weight points are observed.
mandatoryCompanionFields: nearest mapped place and straight-line distance for each observed category
comparisonRule: Compare scores only alongside category coverage; missing mapping can otherwise make a partial score look stronger. Do not rank neighbourhoods using this property-point heuristic.
geographicRule: Score only an origin inside the supplied Calgary community footprint; list nearby points elsewhere if useful but leave the overall score null.
weightsAndThresholds: Explicit product assumptions, chosen for explanation; not learned, proprietary, or calibrated against pedestrian travel.
limits: Does not use a pedestrian road network, crossings, bridges, gradients, sidewalks, winter conditions or accessibility.
Park points and OSM area centres are not entrances and may be far from the accessible edge.
School distance does not establish catchment, admission, program eligibility or capacity.
Health locations do not establish accepting patients, walk-in availability, cost or clinical suitability.
Mapped location does not establish current opening hours or that every local business is mapped.
No Walk Score data or branding is used; no walking-time promise is derived.
